H3541: properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now

H136: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
H3335: to mould into a form; especially as apotter; figuratively, to determine (i.e. form a resolution)
H1462: the locust (from its grubbing as a larvae)
H5927: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
H310: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
H1488: a fleece (as shorn); also mown grass
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H3615: to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H4994: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix

H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H6996: abbreviated, i.e. diminutive, literally (in quantity, size or number) or figuratively (in age or importance)

H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)

H8415: an abyss (as a surging mass of water), especially the deep (the main sea or the subterranean watersupply)
H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H2506: properly, smoothness (of the tongue); also an allotment
H2308: properly, to be flabby, i.e. (by implication) desist; (figuratively) be lacking or idle
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H5324: to station, in various applications (literally or figuratively)
H594: according to most a plumb-line, and to others a hook
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)

H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity

H7971: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
H558: Amatsjah, the name of four Israelites

H3201: to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might)

H2374: a beholder in vision; also a compact (as looked upon with approval)
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H1272: to bolt, i.e. figuratively, to flee suddenly
H3063: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
H8033: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
H3899: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)

H4467: dominion, i.e. (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm)

H3947: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
H6629: a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)
H6258: at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H5197: to ooze, i.e. distil gradually; by implication, to fall in drops; figuratively, to speak by inspiration

H5892: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)

H1323: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
H5307: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)

H2505: to be smooth (figuratively); by implication (as smooth stones were used for lots) to apportion or separate
